big_case.notes: While Petitioner's abstract invitation to retire or curtail McDonnell Douglas at Rule 56 summary judgment is nationally significant and attracted First Liberty Institute, Orrick, a Call for a Response, and four cert-stage amici, this docket was an unpublished, fact-encumbered single-employee transit discharge after a preventable bus-bicycle collision and documented traffic violations, ending in a routine first-post-BIO-conference denial without CVSG or noted dissent.
